How to Spot Fake BAPE and Avoid Scams

The hypebeast community is no stranger to counterfeit goods. Here’s how TheBape.com ensures authenticity and how you can spot fake BAPE products:

1. Check the Hologram Tag

Authentic BAPE items have a holographic Ape Head tag that shifts colors when viewed from different angles.

2. Inspect the Stitching and Print Quality

Real BAPE products have precise stitching and high-quality screen prints, while fakes often have blurred graphics and uneven seams.

3. Verify the Packaging

Authentic BAPE pieces come with branded zip bags and unique barcodes. TheBape.com ensures that all items are delivered in their original packaging.

4. Buy from a Trusted Source

To avoid getting scammed, always purchase from a reliable retailer like TheBape.com, where authenticity is guaranteed.
